cli_help.uquant:
usage: uquant [-h]
              {account-init,daily,account-sync,account-migrate,account-code-migrate,backtest,holdout-manifest,holdout-append,holdout-replay,execution-journal}
              ...

Causal A-share daily portfolio decisions and replay

positional arguments:
  {account-init,daily,account-sync,account-migrate,account-code-migrate,backtest,holdout-manifest,holdout-append,holdout-replay,execution-journal}

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
cli_help.uquant account-code-migrate:
usage: uquant account-code-migrate [-h] --account ACCOUNT [--output OUTPUT]
                                   [--acknowledge-code-change]

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --account ACCOUNT
  --output OUTPUT       destination account file (defaults to atomic in-place
                        migration)
  --acknowledge-code-change
                        confirm a code-identity-only migration with no
                        economic-state changes
cli_help.uquant account-init:
usage: uquant account-init [-h] [--output OUTPUT] [--cash CASH] --data-dir
                           DATA_DIR --symbols SYMBOLS [SYMBOLS ...]
                           [--date DATE]

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --output OUTPUT
  --cash CASH
  --data-dir DATA_DIR
  --symbols SYMBOLS [SYMBOLS ...]
  --date DATE           bounded data-provenance date (defaults to latest
                        common date)
cli_help.uquant account-migrate:
usage: uquant account-migrate [-h] --account ACCOUNT [--output OUTPUT]
                              [--acknowledge-code-change]

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --account ACCOUNT
  --output OUTPUT       destination account file (defaults to atomic in-place
                        normalization)
  --acknowledge-code-change
                        confirm that the reviewed production code fingerprint
                        becomes authoritative
